JOB DESCRIPTION:
At Abbott, we're committed to helping people live their best possible life through the power of health. For more than 125 years, we've brought new products and technologies to the world in nutrition, diagnostics, medical devices and branded generic pharmaceuticals that create more possibilities for more people at all stages of life. Today, 114,000 of us are working to help people live not just longer, but better, in the more than 160 countries we serve.

Abbott is looking to recruit a

Director of Organizational Effectiveness and Culture, EPD (m/f/d)

Based in Basel, Switzerland (EPD HQ)

The Director of Organizational Effectiveness and Culture plays a strategic leadership role to drive organizational effectiveness and employee engagement by shaping the structures, processes, and cultural practices that enable leaders and teams to thrive. Build resilient and agile teams that are equipped to meet the demands of our dynamic business.

Main Responsibilities

• Organizational Design & Effectiveness: Evaluate and improve organizational strategy success. Lead initiatives to optimize organizational structure, capabilities, roles, and workflows. Evaluates the alignment between organizational structure and business strategy, ensuring that the design supports current and future priorities

• Culture Strategy & Activation: Implement strategies to shape and sustain a high-performing, inclusive, and values-driven culture. Monitor cultural health through YVC survey results and drive actions to improve data. Design and implement strategies to improve employee engagement.

• Leadership & Team Effectiveness: Facilitate interventions that improve trust, communication, and collaboration. Deliver assessment solutions that enhance team effectiveness and engagement. Manage Leadership and Team Transitions.

• Change Management & Transformation: Lead change management initiatives by building readiness, resilience, and alignment. Assess the impact, identify risks, resistance points, and readiness gaps. Equip leaders and teams with the tools and mindsets needed to navigate ambiguity, adapt to new ways of working, and sustain performance during transitions.

• Global Team Leadership: Lead and develop a high-performing global team focused on driving initiatives that enhance organizational performance, employee engagement, and cultural alignment. Build strong partnerships with BHR DVPs, Sr BHR Area, Business Area Councils (BAC), and Practice Centers. Navigate complex matrix environments to gain sponsorship and support for OE and cultural initiatives. Influence across all levels of the organization to drive adoption and impact.

Profile Requirements

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in human resources, organizational psychology, business administration, or a related field.

• Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., organizational development, organizational psychology, business administration).

Experience & Qualifications

• 8–10 years of progressive experience in Human Resources, with a strong focus on OE, change management and culture.

• Demonstrates ability to contract, diagnose, design, implement (& pivot), and measure business impact of organization effectiveness and culture solutions.

• 5+ years in a global or enterprise-level leadership role, managing cross-functional or geographically dispersed teams.

• Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leaders and influence at all levels of the organization.

• Experience working in complex, matrixed environments and navigating global cultural dynamics.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to translate strategy into OE solutions.

• Proven experience in team engagement and team effectiveness, assessment, organization effectiveness, and cultural initiatives

• Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills across all organizational levels.

• Demonstrated ability to lead global teams and drive results in a matrixed environment; experience working across diverse geographies and cultures.

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.
Connect with us at www.abbott.com , on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on X @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
At Abbott, we're committed to helping people live their best possible life through the power of health. For more than 125 years, we've brought new products and technologies to the world in nutrition, diagnostics, medical devices and branded generic pharmaceuticals that create more possibilities for more people at all stages of life. Today, 114,000 of us are working to help people live not just longer, but better, in the more than 160 countries we serve.

Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD) is looking to recruit a

Director, Global Alliances - Biosimilars & Biologics (m/f/d)

Based at the EPD HQ in Basel, Switzerland

Primary Job Function:

Lead the strategic management of Global Biosimilars & Biologics alliances with EPD licensing partners, serving as the primary interface to ensure strong collaboration, effective governance, and successful execution of supply and commercialization agreements across global EPD markets. Support the identification and negotiation of new licensing opportunities that enhance the biosimilars pipeline and advance the EPD Biologics growth strategy. Responsible for maximizing partnership value, managing alliance performance, and coordinating cross-functional efforts to deliver business objectives and contractual commitments.

Core Job Responsibilities

Alliance Management & Strategic Partnerships

• Serve as the primary relationship manager and executive point of contact for strategic biologics/biosimilars, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and collaboration across all relevant functions within EPD and partner organizations.

• Build, maintain, and expand strategic alliances with external partners to maximize the value of existing licensing agreements and support long-term portfolio expansion across global EPD markets.

• Establish robust governance frameworks with partners, including regular business reviews, joint steering committees, and performance monitoring to ensure successful execution of partnership objectives.

• Lead the management of partner relationships, proactively identifying opportunities, mitigating risks, and resolving issues to ensure sustainable and mutually beneficial collaborations.

Business Development & Licensing

• Provide leadership in alliance management, business development, and partnership strategy to support the growth objectives of the EPD Global Biologics portfolio.

• Support the execution of the Global Biologics strategy by identifying, evaluating, and engaging high-quality developers and partners, and by negotiating and executing licensing agreements in collaboration with License & Acquisitions (L&A) and other key stakeholders.

• Identify unmet business needs and portfolio gaps that can be addressed through strategic partnerships, licensing opportunities, acquisitions, or other external collaborations.

• Lead and support partner evaluations, due diligence activities, business case development, and internal approval processes for licensing-in opportunities.

• Identify and execute new business development opportunities by coordinating cross-functional requirements, business case submissions, governance approvals, and contract negotiations.

Portfolio Growth & Commercial Execution

• Drive the expansion of the Global Biologics portfolio by securing partnerships that strengthen the pipeline and support EPD's long-term Biologics growth strategy.

• Develop and maintain strategic sourcing partnerships across Europe, India, Asia, Latin America, and other key regions to ensure sustainable access to Biologics and Biosimilars.

• Define and implement annual business plans with strategic partners to support country and regional growth objectives, product launches, and portfolio optimization.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful execution of all licensing, supply, commercialization, and development agreements.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Governance

• Lead coordination across global, regional, and local functions to ensure alignment on partnership priorities, contractual commitments, and business objectives.

• Drive continuous improvement and optimization of partnership agreements by identifying opportunities for enhanced commercial value, operational efficiency, and strategic collaboration.

• Partner closely with Commercial, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Medical, Finance, Legal, and Market Access teams to ensure seamless execution of alliance objectives.

• Ensure internal stakeholders remain aligned throughout the lifecycle of each partnership, facilitating effective decision-making and issue resolution.

Financial & Operational Performance

• Lead commercial and supply negotiations with partners to secure competitive pricing and sustainable business terms while maximizing partnership value.

• Monitor alliance performance against contractual obligations, financial targets, and strategic objectives, ensuring timely identification and resolution of issues.

• Ensure successful end-to-end execution of partnership agreements through structured relationship management and performance tracking.

• Maintain awareness of external industry, market, regulatory, and competitive developments that may impact partnership strategies and business opportunities.

Executive Communication & Reporting

• Provide regular updates to senior leadership on alliance performance, business development opportunities, pipeline progress, strategic risks, and key partnership initiatives.

• Develop executive-level recommendations and action plans to support decision-making and maximize the value of strategic partnerships.

• Ensure transparent communication and stakeholder engagement throughout all stages of business development, licensing, and alliance management activities.

Launch & Execution Support

• Collaborate closely with Global NPI Launch / Brand teams and Portfolio team to ensure organizational readiness and smooth execution of licensing and commercialization agreements.

• Support the resolution of operational, commercial, and strategic challenges that may arise during the implementation and lifecycle management of partnerships.

Supervisory/Management Responsibilities

• The position is directly responsible for the Global Alliance Manager Biosimilars

• The position also supports different functions within EPD and the partner to ensure the strategic and tactical activities are accomplished. Key internal functions where this position must coordinate are, but not only limited to: Commercial, Marketing, Market access, I&D, Operations, L&A, Regulatory, Medical, and Legal IP

Position Accountability/Scope

• Accountability to maintain relations with key partners in Europe, LATAM, India and Asian countries, counted of +5 companies

Profile Requirements

Education

• A degree in Business Administration, Marketing/Sales, or similar.

Experience & Skills

• 10+ years of industry experience, preferably within a Business Development role or related commercial function.

• Strong negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment; willingness to travel frequently.

• Proven track record of successfully negotiating strategic partnerships and managing alliances, with demonstrated success in driving transactions through to deal closure.

• Knowledge of the biosimilar and biologics market landscape, including key industry stakeholders and potential partners, would be considered a strong advantage.

• Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Spanish would be an advantage.

Oggi, 114.000 di noi stanno lavorando per aiutare le persone a vivere non solo più a lungo, ma meglio, negli oltre 160 paesi che serviamo.

La divisione farmaceutica fondata di Abbott (EPD) sta cercando di reclutare un

Direttore, Global Alliances - Biosimilars & Biologics (m/f/d)

Sede della EPD a Basilea, Svizzera

Funzione di lavoro primario:

Guidare la gestione strategica delle alleanze Global Biosimilars & Biologics con i partner di licenza EPD, servendo come interfaccia primaria per garantire una forte collaborazione, una governance efficace e l'esecuzione di accordi di fornitura e commercializzazione in tutti i mercati globali di EPD. Sostenere l'identificazione e la negoziazione di nuove opportunità di licenza che migliorano la pipeline di biosimilars e progrediscono la strategia di crescita di EPD Biologics. Responsabile per massimizzare il valore del partenariato, gestire le prestazioni dell'alleanza e coordinare gli sforzi interfunzionali per raggiungere obiettivi aziendali e impegni contrattuali.

Responsabilità del lavoro

Gestione delle alleanze e partenariati strategici

• Servire come responsabile del rapporto primario e punto di contatto esecutivo per i biologici strategici/biosimilari, garantendo una comunicazione efficace, allineamento e collaborazione in tutte le funzioni pertinenti all'interno di EPD e organizzazioni partner.

• Costruire, mantenere e espandere le alleanze strategiche con partner esterni per massimizzare il valore degli accordi di licenza esistenti e sostenere l'espansione del portafoglio a lungo termine nei mercati globali di EPD.

• Stabilire solidi quadri di governance con i partner, tra cui regolari recensioni aziendali, comitati di guida congiunti e monitoraggio delle prestazioni per garantire l'esecuzione di obiettivi di partenariato.

• Guidare la gestione delle relazioni con i partner, identificare proattivamente le opportunità, mitigare i rischi e risolvere i problemi per garantire collaborazioni sostenibili e reciprocamente vantaggiose.

Sviluppo aziendale & Licensing

• Fornire leadership nella gestione delle alleanze, sviluppo aziendale e strategia di partnership per sostenere gli obiettivi di crescita del portafoglio EPD Global Biologics.

• Sostenere l'esecuzione della strategia Global Biologics identificando, valutando e coinvolgendo sviluppatori e partner di alta qualità, e negoziando ed eseguendo accordi di licenza in collaborazione con License & Acquisitions (L&A) e altri stakeholder chiave.

• Identificare le esigenze aziendali e le lacune del portafoglio che possono essere affrontate attraverso partnership strategiche, opportunità di licensing, acquisizioni o altre collaborazioni esterne.

• Guida e supporta le valutazioni dei partner, le attività di due diligence, lo sviluppo dei casi aziendali e i processi di approvazione interni per le opportunità di licensing-in.

• Identificare ed eseguire nuove opportunità di sviluppo aziendale coordinando requisiti interfunzionali, presentazioni di casi aziendali, approvazioni di governance e trattative contrattuali.

Crescita del portafoglio e esecuzione commerciale

• Guidare l'espansione del portafoglio Global Biologics assicurando partnership che rafforzano la pipeline e supportano la strategia di crescita biologica a lungo termine di EPD.

• Sviluppare e mantenere partnership di approvvigionamento strategico in Europa, India, Asia, America Latina e in altre regioni chiave per garantire un accesso sostenibile a Biologics e Biosimilars.

• Definire e implementare piani di business annuali con partner strategici per sostenere gli obiettivi di crescita del paese e regionale, lanci dei prodotti e ottimizzazione del portafoglio.

• Collabora con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per garantire l'esecuzione di tutti gli accordi di licenza, fornitura, commercializzazione e sviluppo.

Leadership e governance transfrontaliera

• Coordinamento leader nelle funzioni globali, regionali e locali per garantire l'allineamento sulle priorità di partenariato, gli impegni contrattuali e gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Promuovere il miglioramento continuo e l'ottimizzazione degli accordi di partenariato individuando opportunità di maggiore valore commerciale, efficienza operativa e collaborazione strategica.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di Commercial, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Medical, Finance, Legal e Market Access per garantire l'esecuzione senza soluzione di continuità degli obiettivi di alleanza.

• Assicurare che gli stakeholder interni rimangano allineati durante il ciclo di vita di ogni partnership, facilitando un efficace processo decisionale e risoluzione dei problemi.

Prestazioni finanziarie e operative

• Condurre trattative commerciali e di fornitura con i partner per garantire prezzi competitivi e termini aziendali sostenibili, massimizzando il valore del partenariato.

• Monitorare le prestazioni dell'alleanza contro gli obblighi contrattuali, gli obiettivi finanziari e gli obiettivi strategici, garantendo l'identificazione tempestiva e la risoluzione dei problemi.

• Assicurare una riuscita esecuzione end-to-end degli accordi di partenariato attraverso la gestione strutturata delle relazioni e il monitoraggio delle prestazioni.

• Mantenere la consapevolezza dell'industria esterna, del mercato, degli sviluppi normativi e competitivi che possono influenzare le strategie di partenariato e le opportunità di business.

Comunicazione Esecutivo & Reporting

• Fornisci aggiornamenti regolari alla leadership senior sulle prestazioni dell'alleanza, opportunità di sviluppo aziendale, progresso pipeline, rischi strategici e iniziative di partnership chiave.

• Sviluppa raccomandazioni e piani d'azione a livello esecutivo per supportare il processo decisionale e massimizzare il valore delle partnership strategiche.

• Assicurare la comunicazione trasparente e l'impegno degli stakeholder in tutte le fasi delle attività di sviluppo aziendale, licenze e gestione delle alleanze.

Supporto per il lancio e l'esecuzione

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di Global NPI Launch / Brand e Portfolio per garantire la disponibilità organizzativa e l'esecuzione regolare di accordi di licenza e commercializzazione.

• Sostenere la risoluzione delle sfide operative, commerciali e strategiche che possono sorgere durante l'implementazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita delle partnership.

Responsabilità di vigilanza/gestione

• La posizione è direttamente responsabile per il Global Alliance Manager Biosimilars

• La posizione supporta anche diverse funzioni all'interno di EPD e il partner per garantire che le attività strategiche e tattiche siano realizzate. Funzioni interne chiave in cui questa posizione deve coordinare sono, ma non solo limitate a: Commerciale, Marketing, Accesso al mercato, I&D, Operazioni, L&A, Regolazione, Medicale e Legale IP

Posizione Contabilità/Scope

• Responsabilità di mantenere le relazioni con partner chiave in Europa, LATAM, India e paesi asiatici, contato di +5 aziende

Requisiti del profilo

Istruzione

• Una laurea in Business Administration, Marketing/Sales, o simili.

Esperienza e competenze

• 10+ anni di esperienza del settore, preferibilmente all'interno di un ruolo di sviluppo aziendale o funzione commerciale relativa.

• Forte negoziazione e influenzando le competenze, con la capacità di eseguire efficacemente in un ambiente veloce e ad alta pressione; la volontà di viaggiare frequentemente.

• Provato record di negoziare con successo partnership strategiche e gestire le alleanze, con dimostrato successo nella guida delle transazioni attraverso per affrontare la chiusura.

• La conoscenza del panorama del mercato biosimilare e biologico, compresi i principali stakeholder del settore e potenziali partner, sarebbe considerata un forte vantaggio.

• È richiesta una fluidità in inglese; la competenza in spagnolo sarebbe un vantaggio.

Segui le tue aspirazioni di carriera a Abbott per diverse opportunità con una società che può aiutarti a costruire il tuo futuro e vivere la tua vita migliore. Abbott è un Equal Opportunity Employer, impegnato nella diversità dei dipendenti.

• Serve as the primary relationship manager and executive point of contact for strategic biologics/biosimilars, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and collaboration across all relevant functions within EPD and partner organizations.

• Build, maintain, and expand strategic alliances with external partners to maximize the value of existing licensing agreements and support long-term portfolio expansion across global EPD markets.

• Establish robust governance frameworks with partners, including regular business reviews, joint steering committees, and performance monitoring to ensure successful execution of partnership objectives.

• Lead the management of partner relationships, proactively identifying opportunities, mitigating risks, and resolving issues to ensure sustainable and mutually beneficial collaborations.

Business Development & Licensing

• Provide leadership in alliance management, business development, and partnership strategy to support the growth objectives of the EPD Global Biologics portfolio.

• Support the execution of the Global Biologics strategy by identifying, evaluating, and engaging high-quality developers and partners, and by negotiating and executing licensing agreements in collaboration with License & Acquisitions (L&A) and other key stakeholders.

• Identify unmet business needs and portfolio gaps that can be addressed through strategic partnerships, licensing opportunities, acquisitions, or other external collaborations.

• Lead and support partner evaluations, due diligence activities, business case development, and internal approval processes for licensing-in opportunities.

• Identify and execute new business development opportunities by coordinating cross-functional requirements, business case submissions, governance approvals, and contract negotiations.

Portfolio Growth & Commercial Execution

• Drive the expansion of the Global Biologics portfolio by securing partnerships that strengthen the pipeline and support EPD's long-term Biologics growth strategy.

• Develop and maintain strategic sourcing partnerships across Europe, India, Asia, Latin America, and other key regions to ensure sustainable access to Biologics and Biosimilars.

• Define and implement annual business plans with strategic partners to support country and regional growth objectives, product launches, and portfolio optimization.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful execution of all licensing, supply, commercialization, and development agreements.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Governance

• Lead coordination across global, regional, and local functions to ensure alignment on partnership priorities, contractual commitments, and business objectives.

• Drive continuous improvement and optimization of partnership agreements by identifying opportunities for enhanced commercial value, operational efficiency, and strategic collaboration.

• Partner closely with Commercial, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Medical, Finance, Legal, and Market Access teams to ensure seamless execution of alliance objectives.

• Ensure internal stakeholders remain aligned throughout the lifecycle of each partnership, facilitating effective decision-making and issue resolution.

Financial & Operational Performance

• Lead commercial and supply negotiations with partners to secure competitive pricing and sustainable business terms while maximizing partnership value.

• Monitor alliance performance against contractual obligations, financial targets, and strategic objectives, ensuring timely identification and resolution of issues.

• Ensure successful end-to-end execution of partnership agreements through structured relationship management and performance tracking.

• Maintain awareness of external industry, market, regulatory, and competitive developments that may impact partnership strategies and business opportunities.

Executive Communication & Reporting

• Provide regular updates to senior leadership on alliance performance, business development opportunities, pipeline progress, strategic risks, and key partnership initiatives.

• Develop executive-level recommendations and action plans to support decision-making and maximize the value of strategic partnerships.

• Ensure transparent communication and stakeholder engagement throughout all stages of business development, licensing, and alliance management activities.

Launch & Execution Support

• Collaborate closely with Global NPI Launch / Brand teams and Portfolio team to ensure organizational readiness and smooth execution of licensing and commercialization agreements.

• Support the resolution of operational, commercial, and strategic challenges that may arise during the implementation and lifecycle management of partnerships.

Supervisory/Management Responsibilities

• The position is directly responsible for the Global Alliance Manager Biosimilars

• The position also supports different functions within EPD and the partner to ensure the strategic and tactical activities are accomplished. Key internal functions where this position must coordinate are, but not only limited to: Commercial, Marketing, Market access, I&D, Operations, L&A, Regulatory, Medical, and Legal IP

Position Accountability/Scope

• Accountability to maintain relations with key partners in Europe, LATAM, India and Asian countries, counted of +5 companies

Profile Requirements

Education

• A degree in Business Administration, Marketing/Sales, or similar.

Experience & Skills

• 10+ years of industry experience, preferably within a Business Development role or related commercial function.

• Strong negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment; willingness to travel frequently.

• Proven track record of successfully negotiating strategic partnerships and managing alliances, with demonstrated success in driving transactions through to deal closure.

• Knowledge of the biosimilar and biologics market landscape, including key industry stakeholders and potential partners, would be considered a strong advantage.

• Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Spanish would be an advantage.

DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI:
Chez Abbott, nous nous engageons à aider les gens à vivre leur meilleure vie grâce au pouvoir de la santé. Depuis plus de 125 ans, nous avons apporté de nouveaux produits et technologies dans le monde en nutrition, diagnostic, dispositifs médicaux et médicaments génériques de marque qui créent plus de possibilités pour plus de gens à tous les stades de la vie. Aujourd'hui, 114 000 d'entre nous travaillent pour aider les gens à vivre non seulement plus longtemps, mais mieux, dans plus de 160 pays que nous servons.

La Division des produits pharmaceutiques (DPE) établie par Abbott

Directeur, Alliances mondiales - Biosimilaires et produits biologiques (h/f/d)

Basé au siège de l'EPD à Bâle, Suisse

Fonction principale:

Diriger la gestion stratégique des alliances entre Biosimilars et Produits biologiques mondiaux et les partenaires de la DPE en matière de délivrance de licences, servir d'interface principale pour assurer une collaboration solide, une gouvernance efficace et la bonne exécution des accords d'approvisionnement et de commercialisation sur les marchés mondiaux de la DPE. Appuyer l'identification et la négociation de nouvelles possibilités de délivrance de permis qui améliorent le pipeline des biosimilaires et font progresser la stratégie de croissance des produits biologiques de la DPE. Il est chargé de maximiser la valeur du partenariat, de gérer le rendement des alliances et de coordonner les efforts interfonctionnels visant à atteindre les objectifs opérationnels et les engagements contractuels.

Responsabilités essentielles en matière d'emploi

Gestion de l'Alliance et partenariats stratégiques

• Servir de gestionnaire principal des relations et de point de contact exécutif pour les produits biologiques et les biosimilaires stratégiques, assurer une communication, une harmonisation et une collaboration efficaces entre toutes les fonctions pertinentes de la DPE et des organisations partenaires.

• Bâtir, maintenir et élargir des alliances stratégiques avec des partenaires externes afin de maximiser la valeur des accords de licence existants et d'appuyer l'expansion à long terme du portefeuille sur les marchés mondiaux du PDE.

• Établir des cadres de gouvernance solides avec les partenaires, y compris des examens réguliers des activités, des comités directeurs conjoints et un suivi du rendement pour assurer la réalisation des objectifs du partenariat.

• Diriger la gestion des relations avec les partenaires, cerner proactivement les possibilités, atténuer les risques et résoudre les problèmes afin d'assurer des collaborations durables et mutuellement bénéfiques.

Développement des entreprises et licences

• Assurer le leadership dans la gestion de l'alliance, le développement des affaires et la stratégie de partenariat pour appuyer les objectifs de croissance du portefeuille des produits biologiques mondiaux de la DPE.

• Appuyer l'exécution de la stratégie des produits biologiques mondiaux en identifiant, en évaluant et en engageant des promoteurs et des partenaires de haute qualité, et en négociant et en exécutant des accords de licence en collaboration avec les L&A et d'autres intervenants clés.

• Déterminer les besoins opérationnels non satisfaits et les lacunes du portefeuille qui peuvent être comblés par des partenariats stratégiques, des possibilités d'octroi de licences, des acquisitions ou d'autres collaborations externes.

• Diriger et appuyer les évaluations des partenaires, les activités de diligence raisonnable, l'élaboration d'analyses de rentabilisation et les processus internes d'approbation des possibilités d'octroi de permis.

• Déterminer et exécuter de nouvelles possibilités de développement commercial en coordonnant les exigences interfonctionnelles, les présentations d'analyses de rentabilisation, les approbations de gouvernance et les négociations contractuelles.

Croissance du portefeuille et exécution commerciale

• Favoriser l'expansion du portefeuille des produits biologiques mondiaux en établissant des partenariats qui renforcent le pipeline et appuient la stratégie de croissance à long terme de la DPE en matière de produits biologiques.

• Développer et maintenir des partenariats stratégiques d'approvisionnement en Europe, en Inde, en Asie, en Amérique latine et dans d'autres régions clés afin d'assurer un accès durable aux produits biologiques et aux biosimilaires.

• Définir et mettre en œuvre des plans d'affaires annuels avec des partenaires stratégiques afin de soutenir les objectifs de croissance nationaux et régionaux, les lancements de produits et l'optimisation du portefeuille.

• Collaborer avec les intervenants internes et externes pour assurer la bonne exécution de tous les accords de licence, de fourniture, de commercialisation et de développement.

Leadership et gouvernance interfonctionnels

• Diriger la coordination entre les fonctions mondiales, régionales et locales pour assurer l'alignement sur les priorités des partenariats, les engagements contractuels et les objectifs opérationnels.

• Favoriser l'amélioration et l'optimisation continues des ententes de partenariat en identifiant les possibilités d'amélioration de la valeur commerciale, de l'efficacité opérationnelle et de la collaboration stratégique.

• S'associer étroitement avec les équipes commerciales, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de la réglementation, de la médecine, des finances, du droit et de l'accès au marché pour assurer une exécution transparente des objectifs de l'alliance.

• Veiller à ce que les intervenants internes demeurent alignés tout au long du cycle de vie de chaque partenariat, en facilitant la prise de décisions efficaces et la résolution des problèmes.

Rendement financier et opérationnel

• Diriger les négociations commerciales et d'approvisionnement avec les partenaires pour obtenir des prix concurrentiels et des conditions d'affaires durables tout en maximisant la valeur du partenariat.

• Surveiller le rendement des alliances par rapport aux obligations contractuelles, aux objectifs financiers et aux objectifs stratégiques, en veillant à ce que les enjeux soient identifiés et réglés en temps opportun.

• Assurer la bonne exécution des ententes de partenariat de bout en bout grâce à la gestion structurée des relations et au suivi du rendement.

• Maintenir la sensibilisation à l'industrie externe, au marché, à la réglementation et à l'évolution concurrentielle qui peut influer sur les stratégies de partenariat et les possibilités d'affaires.

Communication et rapports exécutifs

• Fournir régulièrement des mises à jour aux cadres supérieurs sur le rendement des alliances, les possibilités de développement des affaires, les progrès des pipelines, les risques stratégiques et les principales initiatives de partenariat.

• Élaborer des recommandations et des plans d'action au niveau de la direction pour appuyer la prise de décisions et maximiser la valeur des partenariats stratégiques.

• Assurer une communication transparente et la participation des intervenants à toutes les étapes des activités de développement des entreprises, de délivrance de permis et de gestion des alliances.

Support de lancement et d'exécution

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Global NPI Launch / Brand et Portfolio pour assurer la préparation organisationnelle et la bonne exécution des accords de licence et de commercialisation.

• Appuyer la résolution des défis opérationnels, commerciaux et stratégiques qui peuvent survenir pendant la mise en oeuvre et la gestion du cycle de vie des partenariats.

Responsabilités en matière de surveillance et de gestion

• Le poste est directement responsable de Global Alliance Manager Biosimilars

• Le poste appuie également différentes fonctions au sein de la DPE et du partenaire pour assurer l'exécution des activités stratégiques et tactiques. Les principales fonctions internes dans lesquelles ce poste doit être coordonné sont, mais non seulement: Commercial, Marketing, Accès au marché, I&D, Opérations, L&A, Propriété intellectuelle réglementaire, médicale et juridique

Responsabilité et portée du poste

• Responsabilité de maintenir des relations avec des partenaires clés en Europe, en LATAM, en Inde et dans les pays asiatiques, compte de +5 entreprises

Exigences relatives au profil

Éducation

• Diplôme en administration des affaires, marketing/ventes, ou similaire.

Expérience et compétences

• 10 ans et plus d'expérience dans l'industrie, de préférence dans le cadre d'un rôle de développement des entreprises ou d'une fonction commerciale connexe.

• Forte négociation et influence les compétences, avec la capacité de fonctionner efficacement dans un environnement rapide et haute pression; volonté de voyager fréquemment.

• Expérience éprouvée de la négociation réussie de partenariats stratégiques et de la gestion d'alliances, avec succès démontré dans la conduite des transactions jusqu'à la clôture des transactions.

• La connaissance du marché des produits biologiques et biologiques, y compris les principaux intervenants de l'industrie et les partenaires potentiels, serait considérée comme un avantage important.

• La maîtrise de l'anglais est nécessaire; la maîtrise de l'espagnol serait un avantage.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Global Associate Director, Patient Strategy & Partnerships

Abbott | Established Pharmaceuticals Division

Make a Meaningful Difference for Patients Worldwide

At Abbott , we believe people can live fuller lives through better health. Every day, our medicines and technologies help millions of people around the world manage health conditions, overcome barriers to care, and achieve better outcomes.

Within our Branded Generics business, we provide trusted, high-quality medicines to more than 18 million people daily across Latin America, Asia-Pacific, India, and other emerging markets. Our portfolio spans areas including Women's Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic Health, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory Care , helping address some of healthcare's most pressing needs.

We are looking for a collaborative, purpose-driven leader to help strengthen the voice of patients across our organization and create meaningful partnerships that improve patient experiences and outcomes globally.
About the Opportunity

As Global Associate Director, Patient Strategy & Partnerships , you will play a key role in shaping how Abbott listens to, learns from, and collaborates with patients and patient organizations around the world.
This is a unique opportunity to build and evolve a global patient engagement capability, connecting patient insights with strategic decision making across Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory Affairs, Public Affairs, and Commercial teams.

You will work with colleagues across regions and functions to ensure patient perspectives help inform healthcare solutions, policy discussions, evidence generation, and access initiatives. Most importantly, you will help create lasting partnerships that improve outcomes for patients and communities.

What You'll Do

Shape Abbott's Global Patient Strategy

• Develop and advance a patient-centered engagement strategy across the organization

• Help integrate patient perspectives into business, medical, and access decisions

• Advise senior stakeholders on evolving patient needs, healthcare trends, and opportunities to improve patient experiences

• Promote patient trust as a cornerstone of responsible healthcare leadership

Build Meaningful Partnerships

• Develop and nurture relationships with patient organizations, advocacy groups, and patient leaders

• Create long-term collaborations around education, support programs, evidence generation, and healthcare improvement initiatives

• Foster trust-based partnerships that create shared value for patients and healthcare systems

Bring Patient Insights into Action

• Establish approaches to gather and translate patient insights into meaningful recommendations

• Partner with Medical Affairs and Market Access teams to ensure patient experiences inform evidence generation and value-based initiatives

• Help strengthen understanding of real-world patient challenges and outcomes

Support Advocacy and Healthcare System Improvement

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on patient-centered policy and advocacy initiatives

• Contribute to discussions that improve access to care and reduce barriers to treatment

• Help elevate the patient voice within healthcare ecosystems globally

Drive Excellence and Capability Building

• Develop frameworks, guidance, and best practices for patient engagement across Abbott

• Champion patient-centered ways of working across teams and regions

• Support colleagues in building capabilities and confidence in patient partnership approaches

Act as an Ambassador for Patient-Centered Healthcare

• Represent Abbott at industry meetings, scientific congresses, and patient advocacy forums

• Partnerschaft mit Teams für medizinische Angelegenheiten und Marktzugang, um sicherzustellen, dass Patientenerfahrungen zur Generierung von Evidenz und wertorientierten Initiativen beitragen

Faire une différence significative pour les patients du monde entier

Chez Abbott, nous croyons que les gens peuvent vivre plus pleinement grâce à une meilleure santé. Chaque jour, nos médicaments et nos technologies aident des millions de personnes dans le monde à gérer les conditions de santé, à surmonter les obstacles aux soins et à obtenir de meilleurs résultats.

Dans le cadre de nos activités de Branded Generics, nous fournissons des médicaments de haute qualité et de confiance à plus de 18 millions de personnes par jour en Amérique latine, en Asie-Pacifique, en Inde et dans d'autres marchés émergents. Notre portefeuille couvre des domaines tels que la santé des femmes, la gastroentérologie, la santé cardiométabolique, le SNC et la douleur, et les soins respiratoires.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un chef de file collaboratif et axé sur l'objectif pour aider à renforcer la voix des patients dans notre organisation et créer des partenariats significatifs qui améliorent les expériences et les résultats des patients à l'échelle mondiale.
Au sujet de l'opportunité

En tant que directeur associé mondial, Stratégie et partenariats pour les patients, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la façon dont Abbott écoute, apprend et collabore avec les patients et les organisations de patients du monde entier.
Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de créer et de développer une capacité globale d'engagement des patients, en reliant les connaissances des patients à la prise de décisions stratégiques dans les équipes des Affaires médicales, de l'Accès aux marchés, des Affaires réglementaires, des Affaires publiques et du Commerce.

Vous travaillerez avec des collègues de toutes les régions et des fonctions pour vous assurer que les perspectives des patients aident à éclairer les solutions de santé, les discussions sur les politiques, la production de preuves et les initiatives d'accès. Plus important encore, vous aiderez à créer des partenariats durables qui améliorent les résultats pour les patients et les collectivités.

Ce que tu vas faire

Former la Stratégie mondiale des patients d'Abbott

• Élaborer et faire progresser une stratégie d'engagement axée sur le patient dans l'ensemble de l'organisation

• Aider à intégrer les perspectives des patients dans les décisions d'affaires, médicales et d'accès

• Conseiller les principaux intervenants sur l'évolution des besoins des patients, les tendances en matière de soins de santé et les possibilités d'améliorer l'expérience des patients

• Promouvoir la confiance des patients comme pierre angulaire d'un leadership responsable en matière de soins de santé

Construire des partenariats significatifs

• Développer et entretenir des relations avec des organisations de patients, des groupes de défense des intérêts et des chefs de file de patients

• Créer des collaborations à long terme sur l'éducation, les programmes de soutien, la production de données probantes et les initiatives d'amélioration des soins de santé

• Favoriser des partenariats fondés sur la confiance qui créent une valeur partagée pour les patients et les systèmes de santé

Mettre en pratique le point de vue des patients

• Établir des approches pour recueillir et traduire les connaissances des patients en recommandations significatives

• Partenariat avec les équipes des Affaires médicales et de l'Accès au marché pour s'assurer que les expériences des patients éclairent la production de preuves et les initiatives fondées sur la valeur

• Aider à mieux comprendre les défis et les résultats réels des patients

Soutenir la défense et l'amélioration du système de santé

• Collaborer avec les intervenants internes et externes à des initiatives axées sur le patient en matière de politiques et de plaidoyer

• Contribuer aux discussions qui améliorent l'accès aux soins et réduisent les obstacles au traitement

• Aider à élever la voix des patients au sein des écosystèmes de santé à l'échelle mondiale

Favoriser l'excellence et le renforcement des capacités

• Élaborer des cadres, des lignes directrices et des pratiques exemplaires pour l'engagement des patients à Abbott

• Modes de travail axés sur le patient parmi les équipes et les régions

• Aider les collègues à renforcer leurs capacités et leur confiance dans les approches de partenariat avec les patients

Agir en tant qu'ambassadeur des soins de santé au patient

• Représenter Abbott aux réunions de l'industrie, aux congrès scientifiques et aux forums de sensibilisation des patients

• Aider à renforcer la réputation d'Abbott en tant que partenaire de confiance dans la communauté des patients

• Partager des idées et des pratiques exemplaires qui favorisent l'engagement des patients dans l'ensemble du paysage des soins de santé

Ce que vous apporterez

Nous nous intéressons aux personnes passionnées par l'amélioration des résultats des patients et l'établissement de partenariats de collaboration. Vous pourriez être en forme si vous apportez une combinaison des éléments suivants:

• Forte expérience en oncologie, en biologie/biosimilaires, en politique, en ADH et en engagement externe des intervenants. La réussite démontrée influe sur les organisations mondiales complexes et les écosystèmes de santé externes.

• Expérience dans les organisations de soins de santé mondiales à matrice complexe.

• Excellente capacité de communication, de narration, de facilitation et de présentation des cadres, avec la capacité de traduire des contextes complexes en messages simples

Pourquoi Abbott ?

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Senior Operations & NPI Engineer – New Product Introduction

Shape the Future of Mechanical Circulatory Support

Join Abbott's Heart Failure business and play a key role in bringing the next generation of Circulatory Support Systems from development into global manufacturing.

As a Senior Operations & NPI Engineer, you will lead the industrialization, validation, and manufacturing scale-up of complex electromechanical medical devices that directly support critically ill cardiac patients. This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence product design, manufacturing strategy, supplier readiness, and production ramp-up from early development through commercial launch.

A unique aspect of this position is the close collaboration between our teams in Zurich, Switzerland and Pleasanton, California. Working as part of a highly integrated global organization, you will partner with experts across R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, and Supplier Engineering to bring innovative technologies to market.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working hands-on with manufacturing processes, and turning innovative concepts into scalable products that improve patients' lives, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

• Lead the transfer of new products from R&D into manufacturing, ensuring a smooth transition from prototype and low-volume production to scalable serial production.

• Develop and implement manufacturing processes, production workflows, work instructions, and manufacturing documentation for new products.

• Define manufacturing requirements and provide Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and Design for Test (DfT) feedback to R&D throughout the product development lifecycle.

• Design, develop, qualify, and release production test systems, measurement equipment, fixtures, and tools required for manufacturing.

• Establish manufacturing routings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), production versions, and associated master data within SAP.

• Coordinate product industrialization activities with R&D, Project/Program Management, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing, Procurement, and external suppliers.

• Define process validation and product qualification strategies, including IQ/OQ/PQ activities where applicable.

• Analyze manufacturing data using statistical methods to assess process capability, yield, throughput, and product quality.

• Identify manufacturing risks and drive corrective and preventive actions to ensure successful product launches.

• Support pilot builds, engineering builds, process validation activities, and ramp-up to volume production.

• Ensure manufacturing documentation packages are complete, controlled, and released before production launch.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, cost, delivery, and manufacturing efficiency.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechatronics, or Software Engineering.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in New Product Introduction, Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrialization, or Operations Engineering.

• Experience working with cross-functional product development teams.

• Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes, process validation, and production scaling.

• Experience with ERP systems; SAP experience preferred.

• Familiarity with statistical analysis and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Fluent in English; German is an advantage.

Why Join Abbott?

• Make a direct impact on technologies that help save and improve patients' lives.

• Lead critical industrialization activities for a next-generation circulatory support platform.

• Collaborate within a truly global team spanning Zurich, Switzerland and Pleasanton, California.

• Influence both product design and manufacturing strategy early in the development process.

• Work with advanced electromechanical medical technology in a highly innovative environment.

• Grow your career within one of the world's leading healthcare companies.

The Best of Both Worlds

Our Zurich Heart Failure site is home to approximately 160 employees , offering the visibility, ownership, agility, and family-like culture often associated with a smaller organization. Here, you can see the direct impact of your work, build strong cross-functional relationships, and influence key decisions.

At the same time, you will be part of Abbott's global organization , collaborating closely with teams in Pleasanton, California and around the world while benefiting from the resources, stability, technology leadership, and career opportunities of one of the world's leading healthcare companies.

The base pay for this position is
N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

DESCRIZIONE DEL LAVORO:
Senior Operations & NPI Engineer – Introduzione di nuovo prodotto

Modella il futuro del supporto circolatorio meccanico

Unisciti al business dell'insufficienza cardiaca di Abbott e svolgi un ruolo chiave nel portare la prossima generazione di sistemi di supporto circolatorio dallo sviluppo alla produzione globale.

Come Senior Operations & NPI Engineer, guiderai l'industrializzazione, la validazione e la scala di produzione di dispositivi medici elettromeccanici complessi che supportano direttamente pazienti cardiaci critici. Questo è un ruolo altamente visibile con l'opportunità di influenzare la progettazione del prodotto, la strategia di produzione, la prontezza dei fornitori e l'aumento della produzione dallo sviluppo iniziale fino al lancio commerciale.

Un aspetto unico di questa posizione è la stretta collaborazione tra i nostri team di Zurigo, Svizzera e Pleasanton, California. Lavorando come parte di un'organizzazione globale altamente integrata, collaborerai con esperti nei settori R&S, Qualità, Regolamentazione, Operazioni e Ingegneria dei Fornitori per portare tecnologie innovative sul mercato.

Se ti piace risolvere sfide tecniche complesse, lavorare direttamente con i processi produttivi e trasformare concetti innovativi in prodotti scalabili che migliorano la vita dei pazienti, ci piacerebbe sentirti.

Cosa farai

• Guidare il trasferimento dei nuovi prodotti dalla ricerca e sviluppo alla produzione, garantendo una transizione fluida dalla produzione prototipo e a basso volume alla produzione in serie scalabile.

• Sviluppare e implementare processi di produzione, flussi di lavoro di produzione, istruzioni di lavoro e documentazione di produzione per i nuovi prodotti.

• Definire i requisiti di produzione e fornire feedback di Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA) e Design for Test (DfT) alla R&S durante tutto il ciclo di sviluppo del prodotto.

• Progettare, sviluppare, qualificare e rilasciare sistemi di test di produzione, apparecchiature di misura, impianti di supporto e strumenti necessari per la produzione.

• Stabilire rotting di produzione, Bills of Materials (BOM), versioni di produzione e i relativi dati master all'interno di SAP.

• Coordinare le attività di industrializzazione del prodotto con R&S, Gestione Progetti/Programmi, Supply Chain, Qualità, Produzione, Approvvigionamento e fornitori esterni.

• Definire strategie di validazione dei processi e qualificazione del prodotto, incluse le attività IQ/OQ/PQ dove applicabile.

• Analizzare i dati di produzione utilizzando metodi statistici per valutare la capacità di processo, la ressa, la produttività e la qualità del prodotto.

• Identificare i rischi produttivi e promuovere azioni correttive e preventive per garantire il successo del lancio dei prodotti.

• Supportare le costruzioni pilota, le costruzioni ingegneristiche, le attività di validazione dei processi e l'incremento della produzione in massa.

• Assicurarsi che i pacchetti di documentazione di produzione siano completi, controllati e rilasciati prima del lancio in produzione.

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo focalizzate su qualità, costi, consegna ed efficienza produttiva.

Qualifiche richieste

• Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria Meccanica, Elettrica, Manifatturiera, Industriale, Meccatronica o Ingegneria del Software.

• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza in Introduzione di Nuovi Prodotti, Ingegneria della Produzione, Ingegneria di Processo, Industrializzazione o Ingegneria delle Operazioni.

• Esperienza nel lavoro con team di sviluppo prodotto cross-funzionali.

• Conoscenze di base dei processi di produzione, validazione dei processi e scalabilità della produzione.

• Esperienza con sistemi ERP; Preferito esperienza SAP.

• Familiarità con l'analisi statistica e le metodologie di miglioramento continuo.

• Fluente in inglese; Il tedesco è un vantaggio.

Perché unirsi ad Abbott?

• Avere un impatto diretto sulle tecnologie che aiutano a salvare e migliorare la vita dei pazienti.

• Guidare attività di industrializzazione critiche per una piattaforma di supporto circolatorio di nuova generazione.

• Collaborare all'interno di un team veramente globale che si estende da Zurigo, Svizzera, e Pleasanton, California.

• Influenzare sia il design del prodotto che la strategia di produzione nelle prime fasi del processo di sviluppo.

• Lavora con tecnologie mediche elettromeccaniche avanzate in un ambiente altamente innovativo.

• Fai crescere la tua carriera all'interno di una delle principali aziende sanitarie al mondo.

Il meglio di entrambi i mondi

Il nostro sito Zurich Heart Failure ospita circa 160 dipendenti, offrendo la visibilità, la proprietà, l'agilità e una cultura familiare spesso associate a un'organizzazione più piccola. Qui puoi vedere l'impatto diretto del tuo lavoro, costruire solide relazioni trasversali e influenzare decisioni chiave.

Allo stesso tempo, farai parte dell'organizzazione globale di Abbott, collaborando strettamente con team a Pleasanton, California e in tutto il mondo, beneficiando delle risorse, della stabilità, della leadership tecnologica e delle opportunità di carriera di una delle principali aziende sanitarie mondiali.

N/A In specifiche località, la fascia salariale può variare rispetto a quella indicata.

STELLENBESCHREIBUNG:
Senior Operations & NPI Engineer – Einführung eines neuen Produkts

Die Zukunft der mechanischen Kreislaufunterstützung gestalten

Treten Sie dem Herzversagensgeschäft von Abbott bei und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle dabei, die nächste Generation von Kreislaufunterstützungssystemen von der Entwicklung in die globale Fertigung zu bringen.

Als Senior Operations & NPI Engineer leiten Sie die Industrialisierung, Validierung und Fertigungsskalierung komplexer elektromechanischer Medizinprodukte, die kritisch kranke Herzpatienten direkt unterstützen. Dies ist eine sehr sichtbare Rolle mit der Möglichkeit, Produktdesign, Fertigungsstrategie, Lieferantenbereitschaft und Produktionsaufstieg von der frühen Entwicklung bis zum kommerziellen Start zu beeinflussen.

Ein einzigartiges Merkmal dieser Position ist die enge Zusammenarbeit unserer Teams in Zürich, Schweiz, und Pleasanton, Kalifornien. Als Teil einer hochintegrierten globalen Organisation arbeiten Sie mit Experten aus den Bereichen F&E, Qualität, Regulierung, Betrieb und Lieferantentechnik zusammen, um innovative Technologien auf den Markt zu bringen.

Wenn Sie gerne komplexe technische Herausforderungen lösen, praktisch mit Fertigungsprozessen arbeiten und innovative Konzepte in skalierbare Produkte umsetzen, die das Leben der Patienten verbessern, würden wir uns sehr freuen, von Ihnen zu hören.

Was du tun wirst

• Führen Sie den Transfer neuer Produkte von der Forschung und Entwicklung in die Fertigung an und sorgen so für einen reibungslosen Übergang von Prototypen- und Kleinserienproduktion zur skalierbaren Serienproduktion.

• Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Fertigungsprozesse, Produktionsabläufe, Arbeitsanweisungen und Fertigungsdokumentationen für neue Produkte.

• Definieren Sie Fertigungsanforderungen und geben Sie F&E während des gesamten Produktentwicklungslebenszyklus Rückmeldungen zu Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA) und Design for Test (DfT).

• Entwerfen, entwickeln, qualifizieren und veröffentlichen Produktionstestsysteme, Messgeräte, Vorrichtungen und Werkzeuge, die für die Fertigung benötigt werden.

• Einrichtung von Fertigungsrouten, Baustücklisten (BOMs), Produktionsversionen und zugehörigen Masterdaten innerhalb von SAP.

• Koordinieren Sie Produktindustrialisierungsaktivitäten mit Forschung und Entwicklung, Projekt-/Programmmanagement, Lieferkette, Qualität, Fertigung, Beschaffung und externen Lieferanten.

• Definieren Sie Prozessvalidierungs- und Produktqualifizierungsstrategien, einschließlich IQ/OQ/PQ-Aktivitäten, wo anwendbar.

• Analysieren Sie Fertigungsdaten mit statistischen Methoden, um Prozessfähigkeit, Ertrag, Durchsatz und Produktqualität zu bewerten.

• Identifizieren Sie Herstellungsrisiken und ergreifen Sie korrigierende sowie präventive Maßnahmen zur erfolgreichen Produkteinführung.

• Unterstützen Sie Pilotbauten, Ingenieurbauten, Prozessvalidierungsaktivitäten und den Einstieg in die Massenproduktion.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Pakete der Fertigungsdokumentation vollständig, kontrolliert und vor Produktionsstart freigegeben werden.

• Treiben Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen voran, die sich auf Qualität, Kosten, Lieferung und Fertigungseffizienz konzentrieren.

Erforderliche Qualifikationen

• Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Fertigung, Industrie, Mechatronik oder Softwaretechnik.

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Einführung neuer Produkte, in der Fertigungstechnik, in der Prozesstechnik, in der Industrialisierung oder in der Betriebstechnik.

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Produktentwicklungsteams.

• Grundkenntnisse über Fertigungsprozesse, Prozessvalidierung und Produktionsskalierung.

• Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen; SAP-Erfahrung bevorzugt.

• Vertrautheit mit statistischer Analyse und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

• Fließend Englisch; Deutsch ist ein Vorteil.

Warum Abbott beitreten?

• Einen direkten Einfluss auf Technologien leisten, die dazu beitragen, das Leben von Patienten zu retten und zu verbessern.

• Leiten Sie kritische Industrialisierungsaktivitäten für eine Kreislaufunterstützungsplattform der nächsten Generation.

• Arbeiten Sie in einem wirklich globalen Team zusammen, das sich über Zürich, Schweiz, und Pleasanton, Kalifornien, erstreckt.

• Beeinflussen Sie sowohl das Produktdesign als auch die Fertigungsstrategie frühzeitig im Entwicklungsprozess.

• Arbeiten Sie mit fortschrittlicher elektromechanischer Medizintechnik in einer hochinnovativen Umgebung.

• Entwickeln Sie Ihre Karriere in einem der weltweit führenden Gesundheitsunternehmen.

Das Beste aus beiden Welten

Unser Zürcher Herzversagen-Standort beherbergt etwa 160 Mitarbeiter und bietet die Sichtbarkeit, Eigentumsverhältnisse, Agilität und familienähnliche Kultur, die oft mit kleineren Unternehmen verbunden sind. Hier können Sie die direkten Auswirkungen Ihrer Arbeit sehen, starke funktionsübergreifende Beziehungen aufbauen und wichtige Entscheidungen beeinflussen.

Gleichzeitig werden Sie Teil von Abbotts globaler Organisation sein, eng mit Teams in Pleasanton, Kalifornien, und weltweit zusammenarbeiten und von den Ressourcen, der Stabilität, der technologischen Führung und den Karrieremöglichkeiten eines der weltweit führenden Gesundheitsunternehmen profitieren.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :
Ingénieur principal des opérations et NPI – Introduction de nouveau produit

Façonner l'avenir du soutien circulatoire mécanique

Rejoignez l'activité Insuffisance Cardiaque d'Abbott et jouez un rôle clé dans la transition de la prochaine génération de systèmes de soutien circulatoire du développement vers la fabrication mondiale.

En tant qu'ingénieur principal des opérations et NPI, vous dirigerez l'industrialisation, la validation et la montée en échelle de la fabrication de dispositifs médicaux électromécaniques complexes qui soutiennent directement les patients cardiaques en état critique. Il s'agit d'un rôle très visible avec la possibilité d'influencer la conception produit, la stratégie de fabrication, la préparation des fournisseurs et l'accélération de la production depuis le développement précoce jusqu'au lancement commercial.

Un aspect unique de ce poste est la collaboration étroite entre nos équipes de Zurich, en Suisse, et de Pleasanton, en Californie. En tant que membre d'une organisation mondiale hautement intégrée, vous collaborerez avec des experts en R&D, Qualité, Réglementation, Opérations et Ingénierie Fournisseurs pour mettre sur le marché des technologies innovantes.

Si vous aimez résoudre des défis techniques complexes, travailler directement avec les procédés de fabrication et transformer des concepts innovants en produits évolutifs qui améliorent la vie des patients, nous serions ravis de vous entendre.

Ce que tu vas faire

• Dirigez le transfert des nouveaux produits de la R&D vers la fabrication, assurant une transition en douceur de la production prototype et à faible volume vers la production en série évolutive.

• Développer et mettre en œuvre des processus de fabrication, des flux de travail de production, des instructions de travail et de la documentation de fabrication pour les nouveaux produits.

• Définir les exigences de fabrication et fournir des retours de conception pour fabrication (DfM), Conception pour l'assemblage (DfA) et Conception pour les essais (DfT) à la R&D tout au long du cycle de développement produit.

• Concevoir, développer, qualifier et publier les systèmes de test de production, les équipements de mesure, les dispositifs et les outils nécessaires à la fabrication.

• Établir les itinéraires de fabrication, les Lettres de Matériaux (BOMs), les versions de production et les données maîtresses associées au sein du SAP.

• Coordonner les activités d'industrialisation des produits avec la R&D, la gestion de projet/programme, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, la qualité, la fabrication, les achats et les fournisseurs externes.

• Définir des stratégies de validation des processus et de qualification des produits, y compris les activités IQ/OQ/PQ lorsque cela est applicable.

• Analyser les données de fabrication à l'aide de méthodes statistiques pour évaluer la capacité du procédé, le rendement, le débit et la qualité du produit.

• Identifier les risques liés à la fabrication et adopter des mesures correctives et préventives pour assurer le succès des lancements de produits.

• Soutenir les montages pilotes, les constructions d'ingénierie, les activités de validation des procédés et la montée en puissance vers la production en volume.

• Assurez-vous que les dossiers de documentation de fabrication sont complets, contrôlés et publiés avant le lancement en production.

• Impulsez des initiatives d'amélioration continue axées sur la qualité, le coût, la livraison et l'efficacité de la fabrication.

Qualifications requises

• Licence ou master en génie mécanique, électrique, manufacturier, industriel, mécatronique ou logiciel.

• Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en introduction de nouveaux produits, ingénierie de fabrication, ingénierie des procédés, industrialisation ou génie des opérations.

• Expérience de travail avec des équipes de développement produit interfonctionnelles.

• Connaissances de base sur les procédés de fabrication, la validation des procédés et l'échelon de la production.

• Expérience avec les systèmes ERP ; Expérience SAP préférée.

• Familiarité avec l'analyse statistique et les méthodologies d'amélioration continue.

• Maîtrise l'anglais ; l'allemand est un avantage.

Pourquoi rejoindre Abbott?

• Avoir un impact direct sur les technologies qui aident à sauver et améliorer la vie des patients.

• Diriger des activités d'industrialisation cruciales pour une plateforme de soutien circulatoire de nouvelle génération.

• Collaborez au sein d'une équipe véritablement mondiale couvrant Zurich, en Suisse, à Pleasanton, en Californie.

• Influencer à la fois la conception du produit et la stratégie de fabrication dès le début du processus de développement.

• Travailler avec une technologie médicale électromécanique avancée dans un environnement hautement innovant.

• Développez votre carrière au sein de l’une des principales entreprises de soins de santé au monde.

Le meilleur des deux mondes

Notre site Zurich dédié à l'insuffisance cardiaque compte environ 160 employés, offrant la visibilité et la responsabilité, l'agilité et une culture familiale souvent associées à une petite organisation. Ici, vous pouvez voir l'impact direct de votre travail, construire des relations interfonctionnelles solides et influencer les décisions clés.

En même temps, vous ferez partie de l'organisation mondiale d'Abbott, collaborant étroitement avec des équipes à Pleasanton, en Californie, et dans le monde entier, tout en bénéficiant des ressources, de la stabilité, du leadership technologique et des opportunités de carrière de l'une des principales entreprises de santé au monde.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
At Abbott, we're committed to helping people live their best possible life through the power of health. For more than 125 years, we've brought new products and technologies to the world in nutrition, diagnostics, medical devices and branded generic pharmaceuticals that create more possibilities for more people at all stages of life. Today, 114,000 of us are working to help people live not just longer, but better, in the more than 160 countries we serve.

Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD) is looking to recruit a

Senior Director, Head of Global Marketing (m/f/d)

Based at the EPD HQ in Basel, Switzerland

Primary Job Function:

• Lead, define, and orchestrate the global marketing vision, strategy, and execution for Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD), driving sustainable above-market growth, enterprise value creation, and long-term competitive advantage across a multi-billion-dollar, multi-therapeutic portfolio spanning 80+ markets.

• As the most senior marketing leader in the organization, this role is accountable for shaping the end-to-end commercial strategy across all therapeutic areas, integrating portfolio strategy, brand building, innovation, digital ecosystems, and go-to-market excellence into a single, coherent growth engine. The Head of Global Marketing ensures the organization consistently outperforms competitors by embedding a data-driven, insight-led, and patient-centric approach across the full value chain from early portfolio ideation through lifecycle management and in-market execution.

• This role serves as a key strategic partner to Executive Leadership, influencing enterprise-wide priorities, resource allocation, and long-range planning, while building a high-performance global marketing organization capable of delivering transformational impact at scale.

Core Job Responsibilities:

Enterprise Marketing Strategy & Leadership

• Define and lead the overarching global marketing and commercial strategy across all therapeutic areas, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives and long-term growth ambitions.

• Architect and continuously evolve the company’s global brand and portfolio strategy, ensuring clear prioritization, competitive differentiation, and optimal resource allocation.

• Translate market dynamics, competitive intelligence, and customer insights into actionable enterprise strategies that drive above-market growth and market share leadership.

Portfolio & Innovation Leadership

• Lead the integration of marketing with I&D, Business Development, and Portfolio Expansion to define “where to play” and “how to win” across short-, mid-, and long-term horizons.

• Drive the identification, evaluation, and commercialization of new growth opportunities, including in-licensing, partnerships, and lifecycle innovation.

• Ensure a robust, future-ready portfolio by embedding commercial excellence into development decisions and accelerating time-to-market for new assets.

Global Brand & Launch Excellence

• Drive breakthrough creativity in all global brand campaigns and instil the need & processes to ensure that this translates through to local brands and local brand execution.

• Establish and govern global brand positioning, architecture, and communication strategies across all therapeutic areas and product categories.

• Oversee the design and execution of best-in-class global launch strategies, ensuring consistent excellence and rapid scalability across affiliates.

• Ensure all marketing programs are differentiated, insight-driven, and effectively deployed through multi-channel engagement models.

Commercial Execution & Affiliate Impact

• Drive execution excellence across regions and affiliates by setting clear strategic direction, performance targets, and governance frameworks.

• Review, challenge, and align affiliate commercial plans to ensure full consistency with global strategies and portfolio imperatives.

• Champion a performance-driven culture with clear KPIs, including sales growth, market share, profitability, and ROI.

Digital, Data & Customer-Centric Transformation

• Lead the transformation of marketing into a data-driven, digitally enabled function, leveraging advanced analytics, AI, and omnichannel engagement.

• Institutionalize customer-centricity, ensuring deep understanding of healthcare professionals, patients, and trade stakeholders across markets.

• Drive the development and scaling of global digital ecosystems to enhance patient outcomes, adherence, and brand engagement.

Financial Stewardship & Performance Management

• Own and optimize the global marketing investment strategy, ensuring effective allocation of resources to maximize return and strategic impact.

• Lead the global planning cycle, including long-range plans and annual operating plans, ensuring alignment with financial targets.

• Monitor and report performance to senior leadership, ensuring transparency, accountability, and timely course correction.

Culture, Capability & Organizational Excellence

• Build and lead a world-class global marketing organization with best-in-class capabilities across brand strategy, creative execution, digital, analytics, and commercial execution.

• Foster a culture of innovation, agility, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Establish and embed global frameworks, standards, and best practices to elevate marketing excellence across all markets.

Management Responsibilities:

• Direct Reports: Multiple Global TA Directors / Group TA Directors

• Indirect Reports: Global marketing organization across regions and affiliates

• Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing leadership team, ensuring strong succession planning and talent pipeline.

• Set clear objectives, performance standards, and development plans aligned with organizational priorities.

• Attract, retain, and develop top talent, fostering a culture of servant leadership, collaboration, and accountability.

• Drive cross-functional alignment at the highest levels of the organization, influencing stakeholders across Commercial, Medical, R&D, Supply, Finance, and Executive Leadership.

Position Accountability/Scope:

• Full accountability for global marketing strategy, execution, and performance across a multi-billion-dollar portfolio and all therapeutic areas within EPD.

• Responsible for enterprise-wide brand equity, market share growth, and commercial performance across 80+ markets.

• Owns global marketing budgets and resource allocation decisions, ensuring optimal deployment of investments.

• Defines and governs the commercial framework for portfolio prioritization, launch excellence, and lifecycle management.

• Acts as a key member of the Global Integrated Marketing leadership team, shaping transformation initiatives, and long-term value creation.

• Drives organizational transformation by embedding digital, data, and customer-centric capabilities at scale.

Profile Requirements:

Education:

• Advanced degree in Life Sciences and Marketing or related field required.

• MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Business, Marketing, or Strategy strongly preferred.

Experience:

• Minimum 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in the pharmaceutical industry, with significant exposure to global marketing and commercial strategy roles.

• Proven track record of leading large-scale, multi-market portfolios and delivering sustained above-market growth in complex, highly competitive environments.

• Deep expertise across brand strategy, portfolio management, launch excellence, and lifecycle optimization across Rx, branded generics, and/or OTC categories.

• Demonstrated success in integrating commercial strategy with R&D, business development, and portfolio expansion initiatives.

• Strong financial acumen, with experience managing budget, P&L responsibility, and investment prioritization.

• Exceptional leadership capabilities, with experience building and leading high-performing global teams in a matrix organization.

• Advanced understanding of digital transformation, data analytics, and omnichannel marketing in healthcare.

• Extensive experience working across Emerging Markets and developed markets, with strong appreciation of market access, trade dynamics, and regulatory environments.

• Outstanding strategic thinking, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at Executive Committee level.

• Fluency in English required; additional languages are an advantage.

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.
Connect with us at www.abbott.com , on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on X @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.

N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.
